Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Ishaan - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
4. Naira - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Nikhil stands in the kitchen. Anjali and Naira stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Naira, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil makes tea for everyone.]

Nikhil (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil chops onions for the curry.]

Nikhil: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil washes the dishes after dinner.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil dances to the music.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil claps his hands.]

Nikhil: "Careful!"

[Nikhil nods.]

Anjali (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil whispers something to Mother.]

Anjali: "Nikhil, look at this."

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Nikhil (surprised): "I really enjoyed today."
